remarks: * highest and best 5pm Tuesday 8/5 * Easy living starts here. This updated 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo at Maplewood Condominiums offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and low-maintenance living-all on one level with no stairs. Inside, you'll find fresh vinyl flooring throughout, updated kitchen counters, newer appliances, a refreshed bathroom, and freshly painted cabinets that brighten the space. The layout offers spacious, sun-filled rooms, including a cozy eat-in kitchen and an in-unit laundry for added ease. A private back patio provides the perfect spot for morning coffee or evening unwinding. Located close to all the essentials on Connecticut Avenue-Costco, Wegman's, Stop & Shop, ShopRite, restaurants, and more-you'll also enjoy quick access to I-95, Matthews Park, and the South Norwalk train station (just six minutes away). Basement storage means you'll never run short on space. Whether you're looking to simplify your lifestyle or invest in a well-maintained property in a prime Norwalk location, this charming condo checks all the boxes. Settle into a home that lets you do more of what you love-with less to worry about.
